instruction: Find all processes in same net ns
output: ns_file=$(readlink /proc/self/ns/net); for pid in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ "$(readlink $pid/ns/net 2>/dev/null)" = "$ns_file" ] && echo "$(basename $pid): $(cat $pid/comm 2>/dev/null)"; done
